memory_update.text: Keep VRT as the reference benchmark for integrated AI data-center physical infrastructure: liquid cooling, CDUs, UPS, busway, rPDU and controls.
Promote NVT to the underfollowed lane despite large-cap size because it maps to multiple node subcomponents: liquid cooling, intelligent PDUs, enclosures, power connections and engineered buildings.

node: Liquid cooling, rack power distribution, thermal controls, and data-center physical infrastructure
summary: Expanded the node using a two-lane Serenity funnel. Vertiv is retained as the obvious reference leader because it bundles AI data-center power, liquid cooling, busway, CDU and monitoring. The underfollowed lane points to nVent as a more focused electrical-enclosure, liquid-cooling, PDU and power-connection supplier, and Powell Industries as a less-obvious custom power-distribution/switchgear beneficiary tied to data-center and AI capacity buildouts. No buy/sell recommendation is implied; these are research candidates for later evidence and falsification layers.
